scope: All numerical classroom examples below are synthetic teaching constructions, not K-Field observations or substitutes for source constants.

E05: Replace generic coverage placeholders with actual explanation, worked-example, practice, diagnostic, and capstone step IDs. A row passes only when the referenced content exists and the operation is taught before use.

For each capstone break the requested product into concrete operations with named inputs/outputs, link each operation to an earlier explanation AND an independently answered practice item; do not merely repeat outcome text.
Use source-exact finite examples where available and separately labeled synthetic analogues otherwise. Recognition-only extensions cannot be required computations.
Record teaching/practice/check minutes per lesson; split overloaded lessons and update every lesson/coverage/capstone link. Shared advanced notation is author guidance until introduced locally.

course_amendments.required_bridge: Teach a square root as a number whose square is specified; define Av=lambda v component by component before eigenpair verification. General spectral proofs are recognition-only unless explicitly taught.

worked_example.checks: Multiply every row for all three pairs. Nonzero modes have length2, zero mode length sqrt(2); normalize explicitly and verify pairwise dot products zero.

course_amendments.practice: C12-EIG-P1: verify A(2,0,-2)=0 and explain scaling of an eigenvector; C12-EIG-D1 test whether (1,1,1) is an eigenvector. Connect to source Emily system only after source-specific operator and ordering are pinned.

course_amendments.required_bridge: Teach i^2=-1, real/imaginary components, complex conjugation, squared modulus, matrix conjugate transpose, group composition and a finite map kernel through explicit operations.

worked_example.finite_kernel_example: Add modulo6 and map to addition modulo3 by f(k)=k mod3; enumerate all six inputs, kernel={0,3}. This toy map is not an asserted Standard Model quotient.

course_amendments.practice: C14-CX-P1 rotate 2-i by i and compute modulus; C14-KER-D1 compute kernel of k mod2 from addition modulo6, obtaining {0,2,4}. Trace the actual source cover kernel separately; do not infer it from the toy.

course_amendments.required_bridge: Define column independence and rank by explicit linear equations. Explain carrier dimension, number of product labels, and projector image rank as different counts.

worked_example.checks: Multiply P^2=P; identify equal first two columns and independent third, rank2 in dimension3; reconstruct input from image+complement. A separate 2-by-3 product label table has six labels and establishes no projector rank.

course_amendments.practice: C20-RANK-P1 apply P to (4,2,-1), retain (1,-1,0); C20-RANK-D1 count rank of diag(1,0,0). Actual rank48 source claim must include exact factorization, assumptions, locator, and source-reported versus freshly verified status.

course_amendments.required_bridge: Teach a declared Euclidean decoder through two normal equations; preserve full residual coordinates as information. This classroom decoder is not automatically the source physical decoder.

worked_example.checks: Solve by elimination; check A^T r=0 and all three entries y=A*c+r. No residual component may be replaced by a score.

course_amendments.practice: C21-DEC-P1 y=(1,2,3) gives c=(1,2), r=0; C21-DEC-D1 y=(1,1,3) gives c=(4/3,4/3), r=(-1/3,-1/3,1/3). Relate represented/syndrome dimensions to pinned source only after local definitions.

course_amendments.required_bridge: Add a local reaction bookkeeping bridge BEFORE capstone: balance endpoint constituent/charge counts; specify whole-object mass state and electron convention; subtract final from initial mass; apply a declared mass-energy conversion; interpret positive release versus negative energy requirement.

worked_example.reaction: Synthetic A+B -> AB; constituents and charge are conserved by stipulated labels, not an empirical nuclear reaction. All masses refer to complete objects in the same stated reference convention.

course_amendments.practice: C21-RXN-P1 use AB mass5.05u with otherwise identical inputs: mass difference -0.05u and released-energy convention -0.5E_unit, requiring input0.5E_unit. C21-RXN-D1 diagnose an inconsistent electron convention before subtracting masses. Actual source examples retain their endpoint conventions and conversion provenance.

course_amendments.required_bridge: Derive the finite geometric sum by subtraction, state |r|<1 for the infinite-tail bound, and solve a finite tolerance inequality by checking powers.

worked_example.information_contract: A bound does not authorize deleting tail coordinates; retain the exact rule/source and resolution history.

course_amendments.practice: C22-TAIL-P1 epsilon=1/32 permits N=5. C22-TAIL-D1 explain why the same finite geometric-tail formula does not certify convergence when r=1. Distinguish absolute bounds from signed sums.

course_amendments.required_bridge: Teach theta/phi or RA/Dec conventions explicitly; in the classroom RA alpha is measured from +x toward +y and declination delta from xy-plane, x=r cos(delta)cos(alpha), y=r cos(delta)sin(alpha), z=r sin(delta). Convert hours to degrees before trigonometry. Then teach discrete constant-velocity updates with fixed origin/frame and seconds.

worked_example.scope: Synthetic fixed-frame constant velocity; not an ephemeris approximation or invented Galactic time law.

course_amendments.practice: C24-FRAME-P1 alpha=0deg,delta=0deg,r=3L -> (3,0,0)L; C24-TRAJ-D1 reconstruct p0=p2-2v*dt and verify units. Actual moving-frame chains use pinned source epochs, origins, and vector composition.

course_amendments.required_bridge: Derive cos(a)+cos(b)=2cos((a-b)/2)cos((a+b)/2) from taught addition rules; identify signed amplitude factor versus its absolute envelope and define frequency convention. Teach a four-sample DFT by enumerating powers of i, with both transform signs and inverse factor specified.

worked_example.shift_check: y_n=x_(n-1 mod4)=[0,1,0,-1], Y=[0,-2i,0,2i]; same magnitudes but different phase. Reconstruct all four entries.

course_amendments.practice: C26-DFT-P1 transform/reconstruct (1,1,1,1) -> (4,0,0,0); C26-DFT-D1 compare full complex spectrum with magnitude-only reconstruction and retain every omitted phase or residual. C26-BEAT-P1 cos(2*pi*5t)+cos(2*pi*7t)=2cos(2*pi*t)cos(2*pi*6t); absolute-envelope peaks recur at2Hz.
